text.description_html:
PBB-SP814040 4" x 4" x Square Corner Heavy Duty Spring Hinge

Packaged complete with a Pair (2) Single Action Spring Door Hinges, Tension Adjusting Tool, Locking Pins plus #12 x 1-1/4" Wood Screws and #12-24 x 1/2" machine screws. Utilizes ANSI template screw hole pattern for use with wood or metal doors.

PBB spring hinges are UL Listed for fire door applications, certified Grade 3 for 250,000 cycles. Pivot point aligns with residential butt hinges gage .123 to .134

The included Tension Tool is use to adjust spring tension. The Locking Pins hold the Spring in tension after it is set. These adjustable tension spring hinges allow you to determine how much closing force you apply to the door (how hard/fast the door self closes).

Specifications for PBB-SP814040 Spring Hinge

  • Hinge Material: Durable Steel
  • Height: 4"
  • Width: 4"
  • Corners: Square Corners
  • Gauge of Metal: .130 (Heavy Duty)
  • Number of Holes: 8
  • Standard Template Hole Pattern
  • Wood Screws: #12 x 1-1/4"
  • Machine Screws: #12-24 x 1/2"
  • Adjustable Spring Torque
  • Non-Handed
  • UL Listed for fire door applications.
  • Full Mortise - ANSI K8107
  • BHMA Certified Grade 1
  • PBB SP814040 Dimensions Diagram (PDF)



***Direct Fit Replacement for Bommer LB4310C-400***



Sold as a pair (2 Hinges)
